prioritization.noRelationships.title: No relationship data yet
prioritization.attackPaths.title: Attack paths
prioritization.attackPaths.description: Assets ranked by how many public entry points reach them.
prioritization.attackPaths.noRelationshi: Add relationships between your assets to see which ones internet-facing entry points can reach.
prioritization.attackPaths.rankedHint: Score = reachable entry points × risk score × criticality weight. Click a node to open its findings.
prioritization.exposureChains.title: Exposure chains
prioritization.exposureChains.descriptio: Paths from internet-facing entry points to assets with KEV or critical findings, ranked by urgency.
prioritization.exposureChains.noRelation: Add relationships between your assets to trace paths from internet-facing entry points.
prioritization.exposureChains.rankedHint: Each chain is the shortest path. Click a node to open its findings.
prioritization.exposureChains.emptyDescr: No internet-facing entry point reaches an asset with KEV or critical findings.
prioritization.dryRun.previewNote: A preview only. Saving the rule reclassifies the matching findings.
prioritization.attackPaths.crownOnPath: Crown jewels on an attack path
prioritization.dryRun.matchedOf: of {evaluated} findings would be reclassified to
prioritization.dryRun.sampled: Sample: the {evaluated} most recent of {total} open findings were evaluated (limit {cap}). Counts for the whole organization may be higher.
prioritization.dryRun.wholeTenant: All {total} open findings of the organization were evaluated.
prioritization.dryRun.floored: {count} matching findings stay at P1 or above: known exploited (KEV) or validated findings cannot go below P1.
prioritization.attackPaths.emptyDescript: Your entry points do not reach any internal asset through tracked relationships.
prioritization.attackPaths.entriesHint: Public assets an attacker can reach directly.
prioritization.attackPaths.noEntriesDesc: No asset is marked as publicly exposed.
prioritization.attackPaths.howReachable: traversal from every public asset following attack-path relationship types (runs_on, depends_on, exposes, stores_data_in, etc.)
prioritization.attackPaths.howScore: reachable entry points multiplied by the asset's risk score and criticality weight (critical=4x, high=3x, medium=2x, low=1x), boosted by open findings.
prioritization.attackPaths.howCaveat: The ranking shows how widely each asset is exposed. It does not tell you which single fix would break the most paths.
prioritization.exposureChains.howEntry: any asset with public exposure, the foothold an attacker reaches directly.
prioritization.exposureChains.howPath: search over attack-path relationships (runs_on, depends_on, exposes, stores_data_in, ...) capturing the shortest route to each dangerous asset.
prioritization.exposureChains.howTarget: an asset carrying open KEV or critical findings. A directly-exposed target (0 hops) is the most urgent.
prioritization.exposureChains.howScore: KEV-weighted danger x criticality x crown-jewel, amplified the closer the target sits to the internet.
prioritization.exposureChains.hiddenNote: Steps shown as "Outside your access" are assets you are not allowed to see. The path to your asset is real.
prioritization.pathGraph.hiddenLabel: A step on this path is an asset you are not allowed to see.
